module_summary: IEEE-754 single-precision multiplier sequenced by a free-running 3-bit counter: unpack, special-case/denormal handling, normalize, mantissa multiply, round with guard/round/sticky, then pack into z.

anchors.name: counter
anchors.why: Phase counter sequencing unpack, special cases, normalize, multiply, round, pack.

anchors.name: a
anchors.why: Operand A unpacked into sign, exponent and mantissa.

anchors.name: b
anchors.why: Operand B unpacked into sign, exponent and mantissa.

anchors.name: z
anchors.why: Packed IEEE-754 product, NaN/Inf/zero or rounded result.

anchors.name: a_mantissa
anchors.why: Operand A mantissa, normalized then multiplied; b_mantissa mirrors.

anchors.name: a_exponent
anchors.why: Unbiased exponent A for special cases and exponent sum.

anchors.name: product
anchors.why: Mantissa product split into result mantissa and rounding bits.

anchors.name: z_mantissa
anchors.why: Result mantissa normalized and rounded before packing.

anchors.name: z_exponent
anchors.why: Result exponent adjusted for underflow/normalization, checked for overflow.

anchors.name: z_sign
anchors.why: XOR of operand signs placed in z[31].

anchors.name: guard_bit
anchors.why: Guard bit deciding round-up with round and sticky.

anchors.name: sticky
anchors.why: OR of discarded product bits for round-to-nearest-even.

groups.name: Phase sequencer
groups.description: Counter selecting each processing phase of the multiply.

groups.name: Operand unpack and normalize
groups.description: Extracts fields, handles denormals and normalizes mantissas.

groups.name: Multiply and round
groups.description: Multiplies mantissas, adds exponents, rounds with GRS bits.

groups.name: Result pack
groups.description: Packs sign, exponent and mantissa, handles NaN, Inf, overflow.
